description:

A sting operation brings down a Denver businessman; a charismatic con man uses the promise of huge returns to put $30 million in his own pocket.

An esteemed doctor turns to white-collar crime and becomes a most-wanted fugitive.

title: American Greed
description:

An accountant to stars mismanages clients' money, pockets millions and marries an exotic dancer.

title: American Greed
description:

The story of Wall Street whiz, Stephen Trantel, a one-time successful commodities broker who turns to bank robbing to support his greedy lifestyle.

description:

Additional footage from the "Lockup" series.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Defending Bacon
At Wichita's Sedgwick County Jail an inmate launches an attack on another, sending him to the emergency room; a detective must get to the bottom of it, while a pastor hopes to get to the heart of it.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E8 — Dues and Don'ts
In prison, as on the outside, a single decision can change a person's life forever; inmates make all kinds of fateful choices, but behind bars, there is no escaping the consequences of one's actions.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E5 — It's Complicated
If personal relationships can get complicated on the outside, they can be even more complicated behind bars; for those unable to cope with them, relationships can lead to a life in prison.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S3 E4 — The Three R's
Sometimes life has other plans, like when the ex-leader of a white supremacist gang faces a whole new reality, and discovers the price for coming clean.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E7 — Hardcore
Producers offer candid interviews and previously unaired footage of some of the most hardcore prison stories.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E3 — Living the Life
The price of crime is often paid by the most innocent, by creativity wasted on destructive ends, but some inmates are determined to better themselves and adapt to life in prison.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E1 — Predatory Behavior
To their victims, they were epitome of terror and the face of their nightmares; five of the most notorious inmates to ever appear on Lockup reveal startling insights into their shocking brands of predatory behavior.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Reap What You Sow
A cell search inside the maximum-security prison results in some heated words and the discovery of a gang manifesto; inmates express their personal feelings in private to the cameras; one confronts his own mortality.
